次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This firm Japanese food shakes when moved but does not melt in a hot pot. It is made from a plant root. It is often gray with tiny dark dots.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Roasted beans are ground into this pale brown powder. It has a warm, nutty smell. Japanese sweets often wear a coating of it, sometimes mixed with sugar for sweetness.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Japanese cooks use this white powder to make sauces thicker. Today it is usually made from potatoes. Mixed with cold water first, it can then be added to hot soup.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal often lives with people. It can learn to sit when asked and may guard a house. It moves its tail and makes a barking sound.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small animal often sleeps inside people's homes. It cleans its body with its tongue and has sharp claws. When it wants attention, it may make a meowing sound.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal is very big. It has large ears and eats plants. It can pick up food without using its mouth first. It does this with its very long nose.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal has four long legs. It eats leaves from trees. Its body has many dark spots. Its very long neck helps it reach leaves high above the ground.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large wild cat lives in groups. It hunts other animals for food. An adult male usually has a thick circle of hair around its head and neck.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large wild cat usually hunts alone. Its coat is often orange with dark stripes. Those stripes help it hide among plants before it moves toward another animal.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This grass eater looks rather like a horse. It lives in parts of Africa and moves with others. Its body is covered in clear black and white stripes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal has round ears and a short tail. Most of its food is bamboo. Its face is white, with dark patches around both of its eyes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal spends much of its time in trees in Australia. It has round, furry ears and a large dark nose. Leaves from eucalyptus trees are its main food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Australian animal has strong back legs and a long tail. It moves by jumping. The mother carries her small baby in a pocket on the front of her body.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small animal eats plants and has strong back legs. Its tail is short and fluffy. Two very long ears stand above its head or hang beside its face.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small animal climbs trees quickly. It often holds nuts with its front feet while eating. Many kinds have a large, fluffy tail that curves above the back.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People keep this small animal in cages. It has a very short tail and stores food inside its cheeks. At night, it may run around inside a wheel.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small pet has a round body and almost no visible tail. It eats plants and often makes high little cries. It is larger than many small pet mice.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small animal has a pointed face. Hard, sharp spines cover much of its back. When danger comes close, it can curl into a ball to protect its softer parts.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small animal spends much of its life under the ground. Its wide front feet help it dig tunnels. You may notice little piles of earth where it has been working.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal flies, but it is not a bird. It feeds milk to its young. Many kinds rest upside down and fly out at night to look for food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This wild animal has a pointed face and a long bushy tail. Many kinds have reddish fur. In Japanese stories, it sometimes changes its shape to trick people.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This wild animal in Japan has dark marks around its eyes. It has a round face and a thick body. Shop statues often show it with a large belly and hat.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This wild animal is closely related to pet dogs. It often lives and hunts with a group. Members call to one another with long cries that carry over great distances.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal has thick fur and strong claws. Some kinds eat both plants and fish. Many spend the coldest part of the year resting in a sheltered place.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large hunter lives near the northern sea ice. Its thick coat looks white, helping it blend into snow. It swims well and often catches seals for food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This heavy African animal spends much of the day in water. Its legs are short, and its mouth opens very wide. It usually comes onto land to eat grass at night.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal eats plants and has thick skin. Its body looks heavy, but it can run quickly. One or two horns grow above its nose, depending on the kind.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal has slim legs and eats plants. In many kinds, males grow branching antlers that fall off and grow again. Visitors can see them walking freely in Nara.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal lives in cold northern areas. Both males and females can grow antlers. In a famous winter story, a group of them pulls a flying vehicle carrying presents.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal has long legs and hair along its neck. People can ride on its back. It also runs in races and once helped carry people and goods.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This farm animal looks similar to a small horse. Its ears are much longer, and its call is loud and rough. People have used it to carry heavy loads.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large farm animal eats grass and chews food again after swallowing it. People raise some kinds for milk. Its young are born without coming out of an egg.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This farm animal has a round body and a flat nose. It uses its nose to search through the ground. Pictures often show a pink body and a curly tail.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People raise this animal for its thick, soft coat. They cut the coat off without killing it and use it for warm clothes. It lives on grass and other plants.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This farm animal is good at climbing rough ground. Many kinds have horns and a little beard. A Japanese children's song describes it eating a letter before reading it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal can travel across dry land. Its long eyelashes help protect its eyes from sand. One or two large humps rise from its back and store fat.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This South American animal has a long neck and soft, thick wool. People keep it mainly for that wool. It is smaller than its relative that often carries loads in the mountains.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal has powerful arms and no tail. It lives in African forests and mainly eats plants. An older male often has silver hair across part of his back.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This African animal is a close relative of humans. It can use sticks to collect insects for food. It has long arms, dark hair, and no tail behind its body.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large animal spends much of its time in Asian forest trees. Its arms are very long, and its hair is reddish. Its name is often explained as a person of the forest.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This forest animal hangs from branches with long curved claws. It moves very slowly and sleeps or rests a lot. Its upside-down life makes it look unusually calm.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal has a long, narrow face and a very long tongue. It opens insect nests with strong claws. Then its sticky tongue quickly picks up the tiny insects inside.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Hard plates cover much of this animal's body. They look a little like protective clothing. It digs for food with strong claws, and a few kinds can roll into a ball.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal swims well and has large front teeth. It cuts wood and uses branches to build walls across streams. Its wide, flat tail helps make it easy to recognize.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal has a long body and short legs. It swims well and catches fish in rivers or near coasts. Its thick fur helps keep its body warm in water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal often floats on its back. It can place food on its chest and use a stone to break shells. Its very thick fur helps keep it warm.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal has flippers and a round body. On land, it moves awkwardly on its belly. Unlike a sea lion, it has no small ear flaps sticking out.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal swims with strong front flippers. On land, it can lift its body and walk on its flippers. Small ear flaps help tell it apart from a seal.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This heavy sea animal lives in cold northern waters. Its face has many stiff whiskers. Two long teeth point down from its mouth, making it easy to recognize.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal breathes air and feeds milk to its babies. It swims quickly and often travels in groups. At aquariums, some can jump high out of the water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This powerful sea hunter is related to dolphins. It has a black back and white patches, including one near each eye. Its tall back fin can rise above the water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This ocean animal is the largest animal alive today. It breathes air through openings on top of its head. Despite its huge size, it mainly eats tiny creatures called krill.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This is a bird, but it cannot fly. It is very good at swimming. It uses its wings to move through the water. Many of these birds have black backs and white fronts.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This very large bird cannot fly. It has a long neck and strong legs that help it run fast. Its eggs are much larger than the eggs sold in supermarkets.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall water bird has very long legs and a bent bill. It often rests on one leg. Its feathers can turn pink because of things found in its food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
The male of this bird can open a huge fan behind his body. The long feathers have patterns that look like eyes. He shows them to attract a female.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This bird has large eyes and can turn its head a long way. Many kinds hunt at night. Its quiet flight helps it approach small animals without being heard.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This dark bird is common in Japanese towns. It has a strong beak and can learn clever ways to find food. People often hear its loud, rough call overhead.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small brown bird often lives near people in Japan. It has a dark mark on each pale cheek. Groups of these birds hop around looking for seeds and insects.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small bird catches insects while flying. Its tail has a deep split, and its wings are pointed. In spring, it often builds a mud nest under a roof.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This bird is common in city parks. It walks with a moving head and makes a low, soft call. People once used its ability to return home to carry messages.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall bird has long legs and a long neck. Japanese paper art often uses its shape. A thousand folded paper versions can express a wish for peace or recovery.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large water bird has a long curved neck. Many familiar kinds have white feathers. In a famous story, a young bird thought to be ugly grows into one.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large water bird has a very long bill. A loose bag under the bill helps it catch fish. It drains water out before swallowing the food it has caught.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This bird holds onto tree trunks with its feet and tail. It hits the wood many times with its strong bill. It can make holes to find insects or build a nest.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People keep this bird on farms for meat and eggs. It usually walks rather than flying far. The male has a loud morning call and a red shape on its head.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This farm bird has a wide flat bill and feet joined by skin. It swims well and often has white feathers. It was developed from a wild bird found on ponds.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large reptile often waits quietly in water. Its long mouth has many sharp teeth. Hard skin covers its body, and its powerful tail helps it swim toward prey.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal carries a hard shell around its body. It lays eggs and has no teeth. Some kinds live mainly on land, while others spend much time in water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This long animal moves along the ground without any legs. It smells with help from its split tongue. As it grows, it leaves behind an old outer layer of skin.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This lizard can move its two eyes in different directions. It catches insects with a long tongue that shoots out quickly. Its skin can change color in different situations.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small lizard is often seen near lights at night. It catches insects and can climb smooth walls. In Japan, its name sounds like something that protects a house.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal begins life swimming with a tail. Later it grows legs and can jump on land. Adults often live near water and call loudly during the breeding season.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal has a long tail and smooth, moist skin. It looks a little like a lizard but belongs to the same group as frogs. Giant kinds live in Japanese rivers.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small pet swims in a bowl or tank. It often has orange or red scales. At Japanese summer festivals, people try to catch it with a thin paper scoop.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tiny fish lives in shallow fresh water. Its eyes sit high on the sides of its head. A Japanese children's song imagines a school of them in a stream.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many of these fish grow in the sea but return to rivers to lay eggs. They may swim against strong currents. Their orange flesh is common in Japanese breakfast meals.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This fish has a long, narrow body that looks like a snake. In Japan, people often grill it with a sweet dark sauce. It is served over rice, especially in summer.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This fish can fill its body to become much rounder when frightened. Some parts of many kinds contain strong poison. Specially trained cooks prepare it for meals in Japan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small fish swims upright and holds plants with a curled tail. Its head looks like a horse's head. The male carries the developing young in a special pouch.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large sea fish has a tall, flat body. It looks as if the back half is missing. Its small mouth and huge rounded shape give it an unusual appearance.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea hunter has several rows of teeth. Its skeleton is made of softer material than ordinary bone. In films, a triangle fin above the water often signals its arrival.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal has a soft body and no hard outer shell. It uses eight arms to move and hold things. Dark ink can help it escape from danger.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal has a long soft body and ten arms, including two longer ones. It can send out dark ink. Its body often looks like a pointed tube.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal has a soft body that can look almost clear. Long thin parts hang below it. It drifts through the water, and some kinds can give painful stings.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea animal moves slowly along the bottom. Many kinds have five arms spreading from the middle. Its shape looks like something people draw to show a light in the night sky.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This round sea animal has many sharp spines. It moves slowly on the sea floor using tiny feet. People eat the soft yellow or orange parts found inside its shell.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This animal has a hard shell and lives near or in water. Two front limbs end in claws. Many kinds move sideways rather than walking straight toward you.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This insect visits flowers and has broad wings. It begins life as a crawling young animal that eats leaves. After a resting stage, it comes out with its adult wings.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This insect has a long thin body and four clear wings. Its eyes are very large. Its young live in water before becoming adults that catch other insects while flying.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This insect spends its early years under the ground. In summer, adults climb trees and males make loud calls. Empty brown skins may remain attached to tree trunks.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large beetle has a hard, shiny body. Japanese children often keep it as a pet in summer. The male has a strong horn that it uses when fighting rivals.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This beetle has a dark, hard body and often visits tree sap. Males have two large jaws like a pair of curved scissors. They use them to hold and push rivals.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tree is famous in Japan for its spring flowers. The pale pink petals fall after a short time. People spread picnic sheets under the branches to enjoy them.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall summer plant has a large round flower head. Yellow petals surround a dark center. Its seeds can be eaten, and its name reminds people of the sun.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This spring flower grows from a bulb under the soil. Its flower looks like a cup on a straight stem. Gardens often have rows of red, yellow, and other colors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This flower often has many soft petals close together. Sharp points grow along its stems. A red one is a famous gift used to show love for another person.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small plant has yellow flowers close to the ground. Later, a white ball of seeds appears. When you blow on it, the seeds float away like tiny parachutes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This climbing plant is often grown by Japanese schoolchildren. Its flowers open early in the day and look like small trumpets. A thin stem wraps around poles for support.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This plant is famous during Japan's rainy season. Many small flowers form large round groups. You may see blue, purple, or pink flowers growing beside a wet garden path.
